name: ink-background

frames.best_why: The headline stays readable while ink clearly bleeds off the W into a swirl.

tagline: A headline written on black water that smears into ink when you stir it.
summary: A full-bleed hero backdrop where the headline is drawn in ink on a simulated fluid. Moving the pointer stirs the letters into smoky curls, clicks drop ink, and the words gather themselves back.
appearance: Near-black fills the frame with a large white signwritten headline, "Write freely.", above a short grey paragraph and two pill buttons, one white and one outlined. When disturbed, pale grey ink lifts off the letters in soft curling tendrils that drift across the black.
behaviour: The letters live in a water simulation: pointer movement stirs them into filigree swirls, pressing drops a ring of fresh ink, and after a pause the ink is slowly pulled back into the letter shapes. The simulation sleeps when nothing has moved it for a few seconds.
demo_content: Headline Write freely., copy about a quiet page for first drafts, and buttons Start writing and See how it works.
search_phrases: stir the letters and they bleed
click to drop ink on black water
use_when: A quiet, memorable landing section where an interactive backdrop can carry the brand.
avoid_when: Low-power devices or tight performance budgets: a WebGL fluid solver runs every frame while active.
customise: Headline text, accent ink, overlaid children and an interactive flag are props; the solver constants and shaders live in the file.
weight_why: A WebGL2 stable-fluids solver runs several shader passes every frame while active.

a11y.note: The ink reacts to the pointer only, but the headline is exposed as heading text and reduced motion shows it still.

issues: While stirred, the headline nearly vanishes and the small copy sits over bright ink.
polish_why: Convincing ink diffusion with a clean static fallback; copy can sit over busy bright ink.
